answer: Pay every identity by its nadir, not its peak. Each identity keeps one thread: a hash-chained log, one task per epoch, twelve deep; weight equals the weakest epoch in it, so one miss zeroes the thread till rebuilt. Threads braid into a vine only after twelve unbroken epochs, and a newcomer locks 20 POA per thread; a broken thread burns the bond. Ten fakes need ten threads — 200 POA bonded, ten tasks every epoch, no pause — while one operator can tend at most two at once, so the farm hires five hands. The chain publishes every link, task, and nadir; a vine with one weak thread pays for one.
